verdict.rationale: Exporting scene and asset data to open formats is a fair question for a 3D engine, but the pack documents no export capability for three.js. The pack lists only GLTFLoader, an importer, which is an adjacent feature, and an MIT license, which concerns code openness rather than exporting user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
